name: First Lady Of The Church
overview: The title 'First Lady of the Church' reflects the biblical ideal of a virtuous woman whose worth is far above rubies, embodying strength, honor, and rejoicing in the future, as described in Proverbs 31. Scripture highlights her role as a crown of glory and a royal diadem in the hand of the Lord, symbolizing her esteemed position and influence within the church community (Isaiah 62:3). Her diligent works and godly character bring praise and honor, reflecting the biblical standard for women who support and uphold the spiritual health of the church.
